title: Efficient amide bond formation via tropylium ion organocatalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34428-34434
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04534C, Paper
Open Access

Mohanad A. Hussein, Karrar Al-Ameed, Ali K. Almansori, Naeemah Jabbar Owaid
An efficient method for amide bond formation is reported using tropylium ion organocatalysis. High yields are achieved under mild conditions with a broad substrate scope. DFT calculations were performed to assess substituent effects on reaction energies, tautomerism, and orbital splitting.
